The '''Kwilaan Starport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] in the [[Mercantile District]], located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Keren/Legends|Keren]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. It was named after [[Kwilaan/Legends|Kwilaan]], the [[Scout/Legends|scout]] who charted the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]] and later led the original [[Human/Legends|human]] settlers to Naboo.

==History==
Under King [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Ars Veruna's]] reign Kwilaan Starport was upgraded to a stellar-class starport and obtained a [[Bureau of Ships and Services/Legends|Bureau of Ships and Services]] accreditation. [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] address at the ceremonial re-opening of the starport compared it favorably to other ports across the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="Secrets of Naboo">''[[Secrets of Naboo]]''</ref>

[[File:Keren_map.png|thumb|250px|Map of Keren showing the Kwilaan Starport]]
Kwilaan provided standard amenities for its type, though cost overruns would be expected when imports of unusual parts or supplies were needed. The government of Naboo attempted in the years before and after the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] blockade to encourage major manufacturers to open branch offices and skilled craftsbeings to open businesses in or near the starport.<ref name="Secrets of Naboo" />

In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the only major off-world presences were the [[Republic Office of Xenosociology]] or ROX, the [[Kazellis Corporation]] and the Trade Federation itself. There was no BoSS branch located here because of the backwater status of Naboo, and the under-capacity traffic at the starport. At that time, the Senator was lobbying for a BoSS office to be opened in order to give a sense of security to potential traders and thus expand Naboo's interstellar economy. After abolishing the tax-free zones utilized by the Trade Federation, however, a clause in the law required the expansion of BoSS into the former zone to oversee the new customs requirements.<ref name="Secrets of Naboo" />

During the great influx of refugees caused by the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], starports like Kwilaan suffered under the strain of managing both the locales and the immigrants, leading to the population of Kwilaan becoming impoverished.<ref name="TDitDB">{{DB|character|theometdanle|Danlé, Theomet}}</ref>

Despite falling on hard times, Kwilaan would survive as a starport into the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>
